hook: Play GTA 6 in Hyderabad without a PS5: cafes from *₹149 an hour*
hook_b: Play GTA 6 in Hyderabad without a PS5: cafes from *₹149 an hour*
tldr: With GTA 6 out since Nov 19, Hyderabad rental platforms and gaming cafes are offering ways to play without buying a ₹50,000 console.

beats.what: ShareStation: GTA 6-loaded PS5 at ₹339/day. RentConsole: ₹2,499 first day, ₹300 after. Cafes: ₹149/hr (Kompally) to ₹250/hr (Banjara Hills).
beats.why: GTA 6 launched after a 13-year wait since GTA V, and runs only on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
beats.care: Cafe rates are advertised PS5 rates and may not be separate GTA 6 tariffs, TOI notes.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Blinkit lists GTA 6's PS5 Standard Edition at ₹5,999 with delivery in select Hyderabad areas.

qs: At what point does renting cost more than buying?
Will gaming cafes become regular hangouts again?

facts.t: GTA 6 had an estimated *17.07 million* pre-orders worth $1.65 billion as of Nov 18.
More than *1,600 developers* at Rockstar's Bengaluru studio worked on the game.

viz.verdict: North Hyderabad cafes list the lowest hourly rates
Renting is cheaper short-term; buying wins for long play

watch: Whether cafes add GTA 6-specific slots or prices as weekend demand builds.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Hyderabad gamers can play GTA 6 without buying a PS5

fact: Hyderabad gamers can rent a GTA 6-loaded PS5 for *₹339 a day*
twist: A PS5 Slim costs ₹49,990, so the daily rental is about 147 days of renting before you match the console price.
